        pairs.append((j,i))

paired = {}
for i,j in pairs:
    paired[i]=j
    paired[j]=i

def random_seq():
    seq = [None]*n
    bp_choices = ['GC','CG','AU','UA','GU','UG']

    return ''.join(seq)
